children: XPartners welcomes Sähköinsinööritoimisto Oy Niemistö to the group. The company adds specialist expertise in electrical, telecommunications, security and automation systems for rail-based transport and other infrastructure, broadening the group’s offering in Finland.

Niemistö is a Helsinki-based consultancy providing design and expert services for electrical, telecommunications, security and automation systems. Its special areas include DC systems of 750 and 600 volts for tramways and metro, power supply and backup power for railways. Niemistö also has particular expertise in the design of advanced automation systems, demanding data networks and radio networks. Assignments range from needs assessment and design to expert support, supervision and commissioning during construction. Founded in 1953, Niemistö has around 20 employees and revenue of EUR 2.9 million in 2025.

“We are pleased to welcome Niemistö to the group. The company has an unusually broad capability across electrical, telecommunications, security and automation systems, together with specialist expertise in direct current systems for rail transport that few others in Finland can match. It broadens our offering and sits close to what several of our other Finnish companies offer,” says

Customers are primarily public sector operators in public transport, where Niemistö has held an established position for many years. Assignments cover areas such as depots, stations, tunnel technology and rail facilities, and the company also serves clients in the private sector.

“We are a specialized expert company with broad and deep expertise in electrical, telecommunications, automation and security systems, and we support our customers’ systems all the way from needs assessment to commissioning. As part of XPartners, we gain more colleagues to exchange experience with and the opportunity to serve in larger assignments together with companies in other specialist fields,” says

Sähköinsinööritoimisto Oy Niemistö is a Finnish consultancy company providing design and expert services for electrical, telecommunications, security and automation systems, with a focus on transport infrastructure. Its special areas include DC systems of 750 and 600 volts for tramways and metro, power supply and backup power for railways, and data and radio networks. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Helsinki.

XPartners Group AB (publ) is a European engineering and design consulting group. The company brings together 2,400 specialists who advise clients across infrastructure, buildings, energy, and the environment. It consists of approximately 90 entrepreneur-led companies supported by a shared platform for collaboration and growth. On a pro forma basis, annual net sales amount to SEK 5 billion and the company is primarily owned by its employees, with backing from the private equity firm Axcel. www.XPartnersGroup.com
Arvid Linder, Chief Communications Officer, XPartners
